verdicts.title: Fantasie sur 'Don Juan', Op. 51
verdicts.note: Exists (Mozart, Don Giovanni K. 527; violin & piano; Paris: Astruc, n.d., plate G136a; dedicated to Berthe Marx-Goldschmidt). IMSLP page title and work title spell 'Fantasie' (full title 'Fantasie sur Don Juan de Mozart pour violon avec accompagnement de piano'), not 'Fantaisie'; Naxos/MDG also use 'Fantasie sur le Don Juan de Mozart'. An orchestral version is on Naxos (Yang). For consistency with existing id 2198 ('Fantasy on Gounod's Faust, Op. 13') the owner may prefer 'Fantasy on Mozart's Don Giovanni, Op. 51'.

verdicts.title: Réminiscence de Martha, Op. 19
verdicts.note: Exists (Flotow, Martha; violin & piano; Paris: Brandus & Cie, plate B. & Cie 12029). Title is singular: IMSLP page 'Reminiscence de Martha, Op.19'; Wikipedia list 'Réminiscence on Martha'; MDG 903 1819-6 'Réminiscence on Martha'. Plural 'Réminiscences' is not found in any source (Naxos calls it 'Concert Fantasie on Martha, Op. 19').

Op. 46 is in Wikipedia's (en and es) opus list as 'Gondoliera veneziana', violin & piano, and the Naxos orchestral series (Tianwa Yang) records it as 'Barcarolle vénitienne, Op. 46 (version for violin and orchestra)'. The queued title matches Wikipedia; Naxos uses the French form. No IMSLP page and no printed edition located (the queued 'Zimmermann c. 1900 (IMSLP)' edition is NOT confirmed), so edition-level confidence is low; drop it if a locatable score is required.

Exists: Wikipedia opus list Op. 1 (violin & piano); Naxos complete violin & piano set (Yang/Hadulla) 'Concert fantasie on La forza del destino, op.1'; MDG 903 1819-6 (Reinhold/Zedler); BnF has a record 'La force du destin. Op. 1' (French print, 'fantaisie de salon'). Not on IMSLP, so the queued 'IMSLP' edition note is wrong; the print is French (publisher not seen).

verdicts.title: Hommage à Rossini, Op. 2
verdicts.note: Exists: Paris: Heugel, 1867, plate H.4631, violin & piano, 'Grand duo de concert pour piano et violon' on themes from Otello, Mosè and Il barbiere; IMSLP credits it jointly to Sarasate and Louis Diémer. IMSLP title is 'Hommage à Rossini' (French); 'Homenaje a Rossini' is the Spanish form used by Wikipedia/Naxos. Prefer IMSLP.

IMSLP: Los pájaros de Chile (alt. 'Capricho'), G major, 1870-71, violin & piano, c. 6 min, dedicated to the President of Chile. Earliest source is a manuscript (Valparaíso 1871); the only edition on IMSLP is a 2023 typeset one (Donghee Kim). Also on the Naxos complete violin & piano set. No historical printed edition, so treat as optional.

IMSLP: 'Preludio para violín solo', E major, 1905, about 2 min, one page, written for the magazine La Vida Española and published there (Oct 1905) in autograph facsimile; IMSLP holds the holograph plus a 2024 typeset edition. Genuine but tiny and obscure; the level 6 guess is probably high (one page of chords/arpeggios).

gaps.title: Fantasie sur 'La Dame blanche', Op. 3
gaps.scoring: violin & orchestra (Wikipedia list); also recorded with piano
gaps.edition: No IMSLP page found; printed edition not identified. Recorded: Naxos violin & orchestra series (Tianwa Yang), MDG 903 1909-6 (Reinhold/Zedler, violin & piano).
gaps.note: Fantasy on Boieldieu's La dame blanche. Low-confidence gap: exists in Wikipedia opus list (en/es) and on two independent recordings, but I could not name a printed edition (web search budget ran out before I could check BnF/library catalogues). Add only if recorded-but-unlocatable scores are acceptable.

gaps.title: Caprice sur 'Mireille', Op. 6
gaps.edition: No IMSLP page found (guessed page URL 404); printed edition not identified. Recorded: Naxos complete violin & piano set (Yang/Hadulla), MDG 903 1909-6 (Reinhold/Zedler).
gaps.note: Title as on the recordings: 'Caprice sur Mireille de Gounod'. Low-confidence gap (no edition named).

gaps.title: Sérénade andalouse, Op. 10
gaps.edition: No IMSLP page found (guessed page URL 404); printed edition not identified. Recorded: Naxos complete violin & piano set (Yang/Hadulla).
gaps.note: Not to be confused with Serenata andaluza, Op. 28 (queued as N25). Low-confidence gap. Also in Wikipedia's list without opus numbers: 'Fantaisie-Caprice' (1862) and 'Mazurka in E' - no edition found, not reported. Sarasate's arrangements of other composers' music (Moszkowski Guitarre Op. 45 No. 2, Chopin Nocturnes Op. 9 No. 2 and Op. 27 No. 2, Bach Air, Handel Largo etc.; Naxos Violin & Piano Vol. 4, IMSLP lists 6 arrangements) belong on those composers' lists, not reported here. The IMSLP item 'L'éventail noir' is a song for voice and piano, not a violin work.
